answer: Because the vine decay is applied at each close, the haven audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 5% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the vault fee to keep them eligible. A 192 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
